title: Trump orders Pentagon to scrap modern jet launching tech on new US aircraft carrier and revert to steam catapults – as it happened

The supposed superiority of steam catapults for launching fighter jets has been an obsession of the president’s since 2017 when, he says, he was convinced by a single conversation with a Navy officer that the electromagnetic system installed in modern aircraft carriers was too complex. title: ‘Unprecedented’ rain kills four in Japan as thousands stranded at airport
text: At least four killed as record rainfall floods Japan's Chiba prefecture – video Japan ‘Unprecedented’ rain kills four in Japan as thousands stranded at airport Evacuation orders issued for 400,000 as torrential rains hit Chiba prefecture as flooding risks remain high despite rainfall easing Gavin Blair in Tokyo Fri 14 Aug 2026 00.14 EDT Last modified on Fri 14 Aug 2026 00.33 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google At least four people died in eastern Japan after “unprecedented” heavy rain that left nearly 7,000 stranded at Tokyo’s Narita airport, and forced thousands to take refuge in government buildings. The torrential rains hit Chiba prefecture, east of Tokyo, on Thursday night, triggering landslide warnings and power outages. Evacuation orders were issued for more than 400,000 people in Chiba and other areas, and about 45,000 homes lost power, as 115mm of rain fell hourly, approximately the same amount usually recorded for the whole month of August. It was the first time the Japan Meteorological Agency has issued the highest level 5 warning for heavy rains and landslides for the prefecture. title: Clacton byelection: Farage beats Count Binface but skips result announcement – UK politics live
text: 23.18 EDT Farage says he will not attend vote count amid 'plot to embarrass him' Nigel Farage has said he will not attend the Clacton byelection count after advice from Essex police about a plot to embarrass him on stage during the announcement of the result. The Reform UK leader pre-empted the official announcement of the result of the byelection by telling supporters he had secured more votes than when he won the seat at the 2024 general election. Farage called the result a “convincing, overwhelming win” that would surpass the 21,225 votes he received just two years ago, PA Media is reporting. However, speaking at a “Farage Fest” event in Essex organised by Reform UK, he said he would not attend the traditional declaration of the results after being given notice of an “organised campaign” to “disrupt and degrade the result”. Acting returning officer Ian Davidson said it was Farage’s decision “whether or not to attend the count”.
author: Adam Fulton and Tom Ambrose

In the week of the UK’s fifth heatwave, in which temperatures in parts of England hit 38C , the property website Rightmove said the heat was influencing how Britons thought about their homes, with more people paying attention to how comfortable a property would be during hotter weather. text: Хуситы после недели мощных ударов по саудовским наемникам начали сухопутное наступление на важный портовый город Мокха на берегу Красного моря. За последние сутки они продвинулись на несколько киломтеров, заняв ряд населенных пунктов. Линия фронта тут застыла еще в конце 10х, но теперь фронт снова двинулся. Потеря Мокхи будет серьезным ударом по саудитам и йеменским коллаборационистам, а хуситы смогут усилить контроль над Красным морем и Баб-эль-Мандебским проливом. Можно ожидать, что саудиты в ближайшие дни предпримут усилия, чтобы остановить или хотя бы замедлить наступление хуситов. Кроме того, ожидается, что в ближайшие дни хуситы могут начать наступление и в провинции Мариб, которая имеет стратегическое значение для контроля Йемена оккупантами.
author: Boris Rozhin
